MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23

2. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x > 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x < 5

3. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31.7

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 19
   C. 22
   D. 88

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. 2/2
   D. Cannot tell

6. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 23
   C. 120
   D. 46

8. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15.6
   D. 15

9. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 32
   C. 8
   D. 9

10. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 25

11. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27
   C. 27.6
   D. 27.7

12. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

13. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

14. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

15. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

16. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
